At NTST 15 ours labels an LP at point 24 where the fold function dips to -7.9e-7 (XPPAUT identical; AUTO-07p's value there is +8.9e-8: no sign change), and AUTO-07p labels two LPs at points 27 and 29. docs/auto-references.md.
